questions.question: প্রমাণ কর যে, $\left|\begin{array}{lll}1 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & \mathrm{p} & \mathrm{p}^2 \\ 1 & \mathrm{p}^2 & \mathrm{p}^4\end{array}\right|=\mathrm{p}(\mathrm{p}-1)^2\left(\mathrm{p}^2-1\right)$.
questions.answer: $\begin{aligned} & \text { বামপক্ষ }=\left|\begin{array}{lll}1 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & \mathrm{p} & \mathrm{p}^2 \\ 1 & \mathrm{p}^2 & \mathrm{p}^4\end{array}\right| \\ & =\left|\begin{array}{ccc}0 & 0 & 1 \\ 1-\mathrm{p} & \mathrm{p}-\mathrm{p}^2 & \mathrm{p}^2 \\ 1-\mathrm{p}^2 & \mathrm{p}^2-\mathrm{p}^4 & \mathrm{p}^4\end{array}\right|\left[\begin{array}{c}\mathrm{c}_1^{\prime}=\mathrm{c}_1-\mathrm{c}_2 \text { এবং } \\ \mathrm{c}_2^{\prime}=\mathrm{c}_2-\mathrm{c}_3 \text { প্রয়োগ করে }\end{array}\right] \\ & =\left|\begin{array}{ll}1-\mathrm{p} & \mathrm{p}(1-\mathrm{p}) \\ 1-\mathrm{p}^2 & \mathrm{p}^2\left(1-\mathrm{p}^2\right)\end{array}\right| \\ & =\left(1-\mathrm{p}^2\right)\left|\begin{array}{cc}1-\mathrm{p} & \mathrm{p}(1-\mathrm{p}) \\ 1 & \mathrm{p}^2\end{array}\right| \\ & =\mathrm{p}\left(1-\mathrm{p}^2\right)(1-\mathrm{p})\left|\begin{array}{ll}1 & 1 \\ 1 & \mathrm{p}\end{array}\right| \\ & =\mathrm{p}\left(1-\mathrm{p}^2\right)(1-\mathrm{p})(\mathrm{p}-1)=\mathrm{p}\left(\mathrm{p}^2-1\right)(\mathrm{p}-1)(\mathrm{p}-1) \text {. } \\ & =\dot{p}\left(\mathrm{p}^2-1\right)(\mathrm{p}-1)^2=\text { ডানপক } \\ & \therefore\left|\begin{array}{lll}1 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & \mathrm{p} & \mathrm{p}^2 \\ 1 & \mathrm{p}^2 & \mathrm{p}^4\end{array}\right|=\mathrm{p}(\mathrm{p}-1)^2\left(\mathrm{p}^2-1\right) \text { (প্রমাণিত) } \\ & \end{aligned}$

questions.question: $\mathrm{m}=0$ হলে $\mathrm{A}^{-1}$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, A = $\left[\begin{array}{ccc}1+\mathrm{m} & 2 & 3 \\2 & 3+\mathrm{m} & 1 \\3 & 1 & 2+\mathrm{m}\end{array}\right] $


$ \mathrm{m}=0 \text { হলে, } \mathrm{A}=\left[\begin{array}{lll}1 & 2 & 3 \\2 & 3 & 1 \\3 & 1 & 2\end{array}\right]$


$ \therefore|\mathrm{A}|=1(6-1)-2(4-3)+3(2-9) $


$ =5-2-21=-18 \neq 0 $


$ \therefore \mathrm{A}^{-1}$ বিদ্যমান।


$ \therefore \text { Adj } \mathrm{A}=\left[\begin{array}{lll}\mathrm{A}_{11} & \mathrm{~A}_{12} & \mathrm{~A}_{13} \\ \mathrm{~A}_{21} & \mathrm{~A}_{22} & \mathrm{~A}_{23} \\\mathrm{~A}_{31} & \mathrm{~A}_{32} & \mathrm{~A}_{32}\end{array}\right]^{\mathrm{T}}$


A এর সহগুণকগুলি হচ্ছে


$ A_{11}=\left|\begin{array}{ll}3 & 1 \\1 & 2\end{array}\right|=6-1=5 $


$ A_{12}=-\left|\begin{array}{ll}2 & 1 \\3 & 2\end{array}\right|=-(4-3)=-1$


$ A_{13}=\left|\begin{array}{ll}2 & 3 \\3 & 1\end{array}\right|=2-9=-7 $


$ A_{21}=-\left|\begin{array}{ll}2 & 3 \\1 & 2\end{array}\right|=-(4-3)=-1$


$ A_{22}=\left|\begin{array}{ll}1 & 3 \\3 & 2\end{array}\right|=2-9=-7 $


$ A_{23}=-\left|\begin{array}{ll}1 & 2 \\3 & 1\end{array}\right|=-(1-6)=5$


$ A_{31}=\left|\begin{array}{ll}2 & 3 \\3 & 1\end{array}\right|=2-9=-7$


$ A_{32}=-\left|\begin{array}{ll}1 & 3 \\2 & 1\end{array}\right|=-(1-6)=5$


$ A_{33}=\left|\begin{array}{ll}1 & 2 \\2 & 3\end{array}\right|=3-4=-1 $

Adj $A=\left[\begin{array}{rrr}5 & -1 & -7 \\-1 & -7 & 5 \\-7 & 5 & -1\end{array}\right]^T=\left[\begin{array}{rrr}5 & -1 & -7 \\-1 & -7 & 5 \\-7 & 5 & -1\end{array}\right] $


$ \therefore \mathrm{A}^{-1}=\frac{1}{|\mathrm{~A}|} \text {. Adj } \mathrm{A} $


$=\frac{1}{-18}\left[\begin{array}{rrr}5 & -1 & -7 \\ -1 & -7 & 5 \\ -7 & 5 & -1\end{array}\right]=\frac{1}{18}\left[\begin{array}{rrr}-5 & 1 & 7 \\ 1 & 7 & -5 \\ 7 & -5 & 1\end{array}\right]$


$ \therefore \mathrm{A}^{-1}=\frac{1}{18}\left[\begin{array}{rrr}-5 & 1 & 7 \\1 & 7 & -5 \\7 & -5 & 1\end{array}\right] $

questions.question: A=$\left[\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 2 & 3 \\4 & 5 & 6\end{array}\right], B=\left[\begin{array}{cc}0 & 2 \\1 & 2 \\0 & -1\end{array}\right] $ হলে BA নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{A}=\left[\begin{array}{lll}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6\end{array}\right], \mathrm{B}=\left[\begin{array}{rr}6 & 2 \\ 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -1\end{array}\right]$

এখন, $\mathrm{BA}=\left[\begin{array}{rr}0 & 2 \\ 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -1\end{array}\right]\left[\begin{array}{lll}1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6\end{array}\right]$

$\begin{aligned} & =\left[\begin{array}{ccc}0 \cdot 1+2 \cdot 4 & 0 \cdot 2+2 \cdot 5 & 0 \cdot 3+2 \cdot 6 \\ 1 \cdot 1+2 \cdot 4 & 1 \cdot 2+2 \cdot 5 & 1 \cdot 3+2 \cdot 6 \\ 0 \cdot 1+(-1) \cdot 4 & 0 \cdot 2+(-1) \cdot 5 & 0 \cdot 3+(-1) \cdot 6\end{array}\right] \\ & =\left[\begin{array}{ccc}8 & 10 & 12 \\ 9 & 12 & 15 \\ -4 & -5 & -6\end{array}\right] \\ & \therefore \mathrm{BA}=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}8 & 10 & 12 \\ 9 & 12 & 15 \\ -4 & -5 & -6\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}$

questions.question: $\operatorname{det}(\mathrm{P})=0$ হলে প্রমাণ কর যে, $\mathrm{x}^2+\mathrm{y}^2=-1$.
questions.answer:
$\begin{aligned}& \operatorname{det}(P)=\left|\begin{array}{ccc}1+x^2-y^2 & 2 x y & 2 y \\2 x y & 1-x^2+y^2 & -2 x \\-2 y & 2 x & 1-x^2-y^2\end{array}\right| \\& =\left|\begin{array}{ccc}1+\mathrm{x}^2+\mathrm{y}^2 & 2 \mathrm{xy} & 2 \mathrm{y} \\0 & 1-\mathrm{x}^2+\mathrm{y}^2 & -2 \mathrm{x} \\-\mathrm{y}^{\prime}-\mathrm{x}^2 \mathrm{y}-\mathrm{y}^3 & 2 \mathrm{x} & 1-\mathrm{x}^2-\mathrm{y}^2\end{array}\right|\left[\mathrm{c}_1^{\prime}=\mathrm{c}_1+\mathrm{yc}_3 \text { প্রয়োগ করে }\right] \\& =\left(1+x^2+y^2\right)\left|\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 2 x y & 2 y \\0 & 1-x^2+y^2 & -2 x \\-y & 2 x & 1-x^2-y^2\end{array}\right| \\& =\left(1+x^2+y^2\right)\left|\begin{array}{ccc}1 & 0 & 2 y \\0 & 1+x^2+y^2 & -2 x \\-y & x+x^3+x^2 & 1-x^2-y^2\end{array}\right|\left[c_2^{\prime}=c_2-xc_3\right. \text { [প্রয়োগ করে ] } \\& =\left(1+x^2+y^2\right)^2\left|\begin{array}{rrc}1 & 0 & 2 y \\0 & 1 & -2 x \\-y & x & 1-x^2-y^2\end{array}\right| \\&=\left(1+\mathrm{x}^2+\mathrm{y}^2\right)^2\left\{1\left(1-\mathrm{x}^2-\mathrm{y}^2+2 \mathrm{x}^2\right)-0+2 \mathrm{y}(0+\mathrm{y})\right\} \\& =\left(1+\mathrm{x}^2+\mathrm{y}^2\right)^2\left(1+\mathrm{x}^2-\mathrm{y}^2+2 \mathrm{y}^2\right) \\& =\left(1+\mathrm{x}^2+\mathrm{y}^2\right)^2\left(1+\mathrm{x}^2+\mathrm{y}^2\right) \\& =\left(1+\mathrm{x}^2+\mathrm{y}^2\right)^3 \end{aligned}$

প্রশ্নমতে det $P=0$ হলে, $\left(1+x^2+y^2\right)^3=0$

বা, $1+\mathrm{x}^2+\mathrm{y}^2=0$

$\therefore \mathrm{x}^2+\mathrm{y}^2=-1$ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: x = 1, y = 2 হলে f(p) নির্ণয় কর, যেখানে I একটি অভেদক ম্যাট্রিক্স।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $P=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}1+\mathrm{x}^2-\mathrm{y}^2 & 2 \mathrm{xy} & 2 \mathrm{y} \\2 \mathrm{xy} & 1-\mathrm{x}^2+\mathrm{y}^2 & -2 \mathrm{x} \\-2 \mathrm{y} & 2 \mathrm{x} & 1-\mathrm{x}^2-\mathrm{y}^2\end{array}\right]$


এখন, $\mathrm{x}=1, \mathrm{y}=2$ হলে,


$\begin{aligned} & P=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}1+1^2-2^2 & 2 \cdot 1 \cdot 2 & 2 \cdot 2 \\ 2 \cdot 1 \cdot 2 & 1-1^2+2^2 & -2 \cdot 1 \\ -2 \cdot 2 & 2 \cdot 1 & 1-1^2-2^2\end{array}\right] \\ & =\left[\begin{array}{ccc}-2 & 4 & 4 \\ 4 & 4 & -2 \\ -4 & 2 & -4\end{array}\right] \\ & \therefore P^2=P \cdot P=\left[\begin{array}{ccc}-2 & 4 & 4 \\ 4 & 4 & -2 \\ -4 & 2 & -4\end{array}\right]\left[\begin{array}{ccc}-2 & 4 & 4 \\ 4 & 4 & -2 \\ -4 & 2 & -4\end{array}\right] \\ & =\left[\begin{array}{lll}-2(-2)+4 \cdot 4+4(-4) & -2 \cdot 4+4 \cdot 4+4 \cdot 2 & (-2) \cdot 4+4(-2)+(4)(-4) \\ 4(-2)+4 \cdot 4+(-2)(-4) & 4 \cdot 4+4 \cdot 4+(-2) \cdot 2 & 4 \cdot 4+4(-2)+(-2) \cdot(-4) \\ -4 \cdot(-2)+2 \cdot 4+(-4)(-4) & -4 \cdot 4+2 \cdot 4+(-4) \cdot 2 & -4 \cdot 4+2 \cdot(-2)+(-4) \cdot(-4)\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}$


$\begin{aligned} & =\left[\begin{array}{rrr}4 & 16 & -32 \\ 16 & 28 & 16 \\ 32 & -16 & -4\end{array}\right] \\ & \mathrm{P}^3=\mathrm{P}^2 \cdot \mathrm{P} \text {. } \\ & =\left[\begin{array}{rrr}4 & 16 & -32 \\ 16 & 28 & 16 \\ 32 & -16 & -4\end{array}\right]\left[\begin{array}{ccc}-2 & 4 & 4 \\ 4 & 4 & -2 \\ -4 & 2 & -4\end{array}\right] \\ & =\left[\begin{array}{lll}4(-2)+16 \cdot 4+(-32) \cdot(-4) & 4 \cdot 4+16 \cdot 4+(-32) \cdot 2 & 4 \cdot 4+16(-2)+(-32)(-4) \\ 16 \cdot(-2)+28 \cdot 4+16(-4) & 16+4+28 \cdot 4+16 \cdot 2 & 16 \cdot 4+22(-2)+16 \cdot(-4) \\ 32(-2)+(-16) 4+(-4)(-4) & 32 \cdot 4+1-16) \cdot 4+(-4) \cdot 2 & 32 \cdot 4+(-16) \cdot(-2)+(-4)\end{array}\right] \\ & =\left[\begin{array}{rrr}184 & 16 & 112 \\ 16 & 208 & -56 \\ -112 & 56 & 176\end{array}\right] \\ & \text { এখन, } f(x)=x^3-3 x+2 I \\ & \therefore \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{P})=\mathrm{P}^3-3 \mathrm{P}+2 \mathrm{I} \\ & =\left[\begin{array}{rrr}184 & 16 & 112 \\ 16 & 208 & -56 \\ -112 & 56 & 176\end{array}\right]-3\left[\begin{array}{ccc}-2 & 4 & 4 \\ 4 & 4 & -2 \\ -4 & 2 & -4\end{array}\right]+2\left[\begin{array}{lll}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{array}\right] \\ & =\left[\begin{array}{rrr}184 & 16 & 112 \\ 16 & 208 & -56 \\ -112 & 56 & 176\end{array}\right]-\left[\begin{array}{rrr}-6 & 12 & 12 \\ 12 & 12 & -6 \\ -12 & 6 & -12\end{array}\right]+\left[\begin{array}{lll}2 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2\end{array}\right] \\ & =\left[\begin{array}{rrr}184+6+2 & 16-12-0 & 112-12-0 \\ 16-12+0 & 208-12+2 & -56+6+0 \\ -112+12+0 & 56-6+0 & 176+12+2\end{array}\right] \\ & =\left[\begin{array}{rrr}192 & 4 & 100 \\ 4 & 198 & -50 \\ -100 & 50 & 190\end{array}\right] \\ & \therefore \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{P})=\left[\begin{array}{rrr}192 & 4 & 100 \\ 4 & 198 & -50 \\ -100 & 50 & 190\end{array}\right] \\ & \end{aligned}$

questions.question: AB রেখা x -অক্ষের ধনাত্মক দিকেন সাথে যে কোণ উৎপন্ন করে তা নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, AB রেখার সমীকরণ, $x+y=4$


$\begin{aligned}& \text { বা, } y=-x+4 \\& \therefore A B \text { রেখার ঢাল }=-1\end{aligned}$


$\mathrm{AB}$ রেখা $\mathrm{x}$ অক্ষের ধনাত্মক দিকের সাথে $\theta$ কোণ উৎপন্ন করলে,


$\tan \theta=-1$


বা, $\tan \theta=\tan 135^{\circ}$


$\therefore \theta=135^{\circ}$


$\therefore \mathrm{AB}$ রেখা $\mathrm{x}$-অক্ষের ধনাত্মক দিকের সাথে $135^{\circ}$ কোপ উৎপন্ন করে।

questions.answer:

$\mathrm{AB}$ এর মধ্যবিন্দু $=\mathrm{P}\left(\frac{2+5}{2}, \frac{1+2}{2}\right)=\mathrm{P}\left(\frac{7}{2}, \frac{3}{2}\right)$

 

$\mathrm{AB}$ রেখার ঢাল $=\frac{2-1}{5-2}=\frac{1}{3}$

 

AB রেখা এবং CD রেখা পরস্পর লম্ব।

 

$\therefore \mathrm{CD}$ রেখার ঢাল, $\mathrm{m}=-3$

 

$\therefore \mathrm{P}\left(\frac{7}{2}, \frac{3}{2}\right)$ বিন্দুগামী এবং -3 ঢালবিশিষ্ট রেখার সমীকরণ,

 

$\mathrm{y}-\mathrm{y}_{1}=\mathrm{m}\left(\mathrm{x}-\mathrm{x}_{1}\right)$

 

বা, $y-\frac{3}{2}=-3\left(x-\frac{7}{2}\right)$

 

বা, $2 y-3=-3(2 x-7)$

 

বা, $2 y-3=-6 x+21$

 

বা, $6 x+2 y=24$

 

বা, $3 x+y=12$

 

$\therefore \mathrm{CD}$ রেখার সমীকরণ $3 \mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}=12$.

questions.question: AE এবং CD রেখাদ্বয়ের অন্তর্গত স্থুলকোণের সমদ্বিখণ্ডকের সমীকরণ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
এখানে, $\mathrm{A}(2,1), \mathrm{E}(0,3)$

 

$\mathrm{AE}$ রেখার ঢাল, $\mathrm{m}=\frac{3-1}{0-2}=\frac{2}{-2}=-1$

 

$\mathrm{A}(2,1)$ বিন্দুগামী এবং - 1 ঢালবিশিষ্ট রেখার সমীকরণ,

 

$y-1=-1(x-2)$

 

বা, $y-1=-x+2$

 

বা, $x+y-3=0$

 

'খ' হতে প্রাপ্ত, CD রেখার সমীকরণ, $3 \mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}-12=0$....... (iii)

 

$\mathrm{AE}$ রেখার সমীকরণ, $\mathrm{x}+\mathrm{y}-3=0 .......... (iv)$

 

এখন, $\mathrm{a}_{1} \mathrm{a}_{2}+\mathrm{b}_{1} \mathrm{~b}_{2}=3 \cdot 1+1 \cdot 1=4>0$

 

$\therefore$ (iii) ও (iv) এর অন্তর্গত স্থুলকোণের সমদ্বিখন্ডকে সমীকরণ,

 

$\frac{3 x+y-12}{\sqrt{3^{2}+1^{2}}}=\frac{x+y-3}{\sqrt{1^{2}+1^{2}}}$

 

বা, $\frac{3 x+y-12}{\sqrt{10}}=\frac{x+y-3}{\sqrt{2}}$

 

বা, $\frac{3 x+y-12}{\sqrt{5}}=x+y-3$

 

বা, $3 x+y-12=\sqrt{5} x+\sqrt{5} y-3 \sqrt{5}$

 

$\therefore(3-\sqrt{5}) \mathrm{x}+(1-\sqrt{5}) \mathrm{y}+3 \sqrt{5}-12=0$

 

নির্ণেয় স্থূকোণের সমদ্ধিখণ্ডকের সমীকরণ,

 

$(3-\sqrt{5}) x+(1-\sqrt{5}) y+3 \sqrt{5}-12=0$

questions.question: $y=\sin \left\{2 \tan ^{-1} \sqrt{\left(\frac{1-x}{1+x}\right)}\right\}$ হলে $\frac{d y}{d x}$ নির্ণয় কর ।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $y=\sin \left\{2 \tan ^{-1} \sqrt{\frac{1-x}{1+x}}\right\}$

 

ধরি, $x=\cos \theta$

 

বা, $\theta=\cos ^{-1} \mathrm{x}$

 

$\therefore y=\sin \left\{2 \tan ^{-1} \sqrt{\frac{1-\cos \theta}{1+\cos \theta}}\right\}$

 

$=\sin \left\{2 \tan ^{-1} \sqrt{\frac{2 \sin ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}}{2 \cos ^{2} \frac{\theta}{2}}}\right\}$

 

$=\sin \left\{2 \tan ^{-1} \tan \frac{\theta}{2}\right\}=\sin \left(2 \cdot \frac{\theta}{2}\right)=\sin \theta$

 

বা, $\mathrm{y}=\sin \left(\cos ^{-1} \mathrm{x}\right)$

 

বা, $\frac{d y}{d x}=\frac{d}{d x}\left\{\sin \left(\cos ^{-1} x\right)\right\}$

 

বা, $\frac{d y}{d x}=\cos \left(\cos ^{-1} x\right) \frac{-1}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}$

 

$\therefore \frac{\mathrm{dy}}{\mathrm{dx}}=\frac{-\mathrm{x}}{\sqrt{1-\mathrm{x}^{2}}}$

 

নির্ণেয় $\frac{d y}{d x}=\frac{-x}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}$.

questions.question: মূল নিয়মে $x$ এর সাপেক্ষে $\mathbf{f}(3 \mathbf{x})$ এর অন্তরজ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\begin{aligned}& \text { দেওয়া আছে, } \mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\tan \mathrm{x} \\& \therefore \mathrm{f}(3 \mathrm{x})=\tan 3 \mathrm{x} \\& \text { ধরি, } g(x)=f(3 x)=\tan 3 x \\& \therefore g(x+h)=\tan (3 x+3 h) \\& \text { মূল নিয়মের সংংজ্ঞ|নুসারে, } \\& \frac{d}{d x} g(x)=\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{g(x+h)-g(x)}{h} \\& =\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{\tan (3 x+3 h)-\tan 3 x}{h} \\& =\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{h}\left[\frac{\sin (3 x+3 h)}{\cos (3 x+3 h)}-\frac{\sin 3 x}{\cos 3 x}\right] \\& =\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{h}\left[\frac{\sin (3 x+3 h) \cdot \cos 3 x-\cos (3 x+3 h) \cdot \sin 3 x}{\cos (3 x+3 h) \cdot \cos 3 x}\right] \\& =\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{h} \cdot \frac{\sin (3 x+3 h-3 x)}{\cos (3 x+3 h) \cdot \cos 3 x} \\& =\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{\sin 3 h}{h} \cdot \frac{1}{\cos (3 x+3 h) \cdot \cos 3 x} \\& =\lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{\sin 3 h}{3 h} \lim _{h \rightarrow 0} \frac{1}{\cos (3 x+3 h) \cos 3 x} \\& {[\because \mathrm{h} \rightarrow 0 \text { হলে } 3 \mathrm{~h} \rightarrow 0]} \\& =3 \cdot \frac{1}{\cos (3 x+0) \cdot \cos 3 x} \\& =3 \cdot \frac{1}{\cos 3 x \cdot \cos 3 x}=3 \cdot \frac{1}{\cos ^{2} 3 x}=3 \sec ^{2} 3 x \\& \therefore \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{dx}} \mathrm{f}(3 \mathrm{x})=3 \sec ^{2} 3 \mathrm{x} \text {. }\end{aligned}$

 

নির্ণেয় অন্তজ : $3 \sec ^{2} 3 \mathrm{x}$.

questions.question: $\mathbf{y}=\mathbf{f}(\mathbf{x})+\sqrt{\mathbf{f}^{\prime}(\mathbf{x})}$ হলে প্রমাণ কর যে, $(\mathbf{1}-\sin \mathbf{x}) \mathbf{y}_{2}-\mathbf{y}=\mathbf{0}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\tan \mathrm{x}$

 

বা, $\mathrm{f}'(\mathrm{x})=\sec ^{2} \mathrm{x}$

 

বা, $y=f(x)+\sqrt{f^{\prime}(x)}$

 

বা, $y=\tan x+\sqrt{\sec ^{2} x}$

 

বা, $y=\tan x+\sec x$

 

বা, $y=\frac{\sin x}{\cos x}+\frac{1}{\cos x}$

 

বা, $y=\frac{\sin x+1}{\cos x}$.

 

x এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরীকরণ করে পাই,

 

$y_{1}=\frac{\cos x \frac{d}{d x}(\sin x+1)-(\sin x+1) \frac{d}{d x} \cos x}{\cos ^{2} x}$

 

বা, $y_{1}=\frac{\cos x \cdot \cos x+(\sin x+1) \sin x}{\cos ^{2} x}$

 

বা, $y_{1}=\frac{\cos ^{2} x+\sin ^{2} x+\sin x}{1-\sin ^{2} x}$

 

বা, $\mathrm{y}_{1}=\frac{1+\sin \mathrm{x}}{(1+\sin \mathrm{x})(1-\sin \mathrm{x})}\left[\because \sin ^{2} \mathrm{x}+\cos ^{2} \mathrm{x}=1\right]$

 

বা, $\mathrm{y}_{1}=\frac{1}{1-\sin \mathrm{x}}$

 

আবার, $\mathrm{x}$ এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরীকরণ করে পাই,

 

$y_{2}=\frac{(1-\sin x) \frac{d}{d x}(1)-1 \frac{d}{d x}(1-\sin x)}{(1-\sin x)^{2}}$

 

বা, $y_{2}=\frac{(1-\sin x) \cdot 0-1 \cdot(0-\cos x)}{(1-\sin x)^{2}}$

 

বা, $\mathrm{y}_{2}=\frac{\cos \mathrm{x}}{(1-\sin \mathrm{x})^{2}}$

 

বা, $(1-\sin x) y_{2}=\frac{\cos x}{1-\sin x}$

 

বা, $(1-\sin \mathrm{x}) \mathrm{y}_{2}=\frac{\cos ^{\circ} \mathrm{x} \cdot(1+\sin \mathrm{x})}{(1+\sin \mathrm{x})(1-\sin \mathrm{x})}$

 

বা, $(1-\sin x) y_{2}=\frac{\cos x(1+\sin x}{1-\sin ^{2} x}$

 

বা, $(1-\sin x) y_{2}=\frac{\cos x(1+\sin x)}{\cos ^{2} x}$

 

বা, $(1-\sin x) \cdot y_{2}=\frac{1+\sin x}{\cos x}$

 

বা, $(1-\sin \mathrm{x}) \mathrm{y}_{2}=\mathrm{y}$[(1) নং সমীকরণ হতে ]

 

$\therefore(1-\sin \mathrm{x}) \mathrm{y}_{2}-\mathrm{y}=0$. (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $y=\operatorname{cosec}^{-1} \frac{1+x^{2}}{2 x}$ হলে $\frac{d y}{d x}$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $y=\operatorname{cosec}^{-1} \frac{1+x^{2}}{2 x}$

 

$\begin{aligned}\text { বা, } y=\sin ^{-1} \frac{2 x}{1+x^{2}} \\\therefore y=2 \tan ^{-1} x\end{aligned}$

 

$\mathrm{x}$ এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরীকরণ করে পাই,

 

$\frac{d y}{d x}=\frac{d}{d x}\left(2 \tan ^{-1} x\right)=2 \cdot \frac{1}{1+x^{2}}=\frac{2}{1+x^{2}}$

 

নির্ণেয় $\frac{d y}{d x}=\frac{2}{1+x^{2}}$.

questions.question: $y=\tan \{\operatorname{mf}(x)\}$ হলে প্রমাণ কর যে, $\left(1+x^{2}\right) y_{2}+2 x y_{1}=2 m y_{1}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $f(x)=\tan ^{-1} x$

 

এবং $\mathrm{y}=\tan \{\mathrm{m} f(x)\}$

 

বা, $y=\tan \left\{\operatorname{mtan}^{-1} x\right\}$;

 

বা, $\tan ^{-1} y=\tan ^{-1} x$

 

x এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরীকরণ করে পাই,

 

$\frac{d}{d x}\left(\tan ^{-1} y\right)=\frac{d}{d x}\left(\operatorname{mtan}^{-} x\right)$

 

বা, $\frac{1}{1+\mathrm{y}^{2}} \cdot \mathrm{y}_{\mathrm{i}}=\mathrm{m} \frac{1}{1+\mathrm{x}^{2}}$

 

বা, $\left(1+x^{2}\right) y_{1}=m\left(1+y^{2}\right)$

 

আবার, x এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরীকরণ করে পাই,

 

$\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{dx}}\left\{\left(1+\mathrm{x}^{2}\right) \mathrm{y}_{1}\right\} ;=\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{dx}}\left\{\mathrm{m}\left(1+\mathrm{y}^{2}\right)\right\}$

 

বা, $\left(1+x^{2}\right) \frac{d}{d x}\left(y_{1}\right)+y_{1} \frac{d}{d x}\left(1+x^{2}\right)=m\left(0+2 y \cdot y_{1}\right)$

 

বা, $\left(1+x^{2}\right) y_{2}+y_{1}, 2 x=2$ myy $_{1}$

 

$\therefore\left(1+\mathrm{x}^{2}\right) \mathrm{y}_{2}+2 \mathrm{xy}_{1}=2 \mathrm{myy}_{1}$. (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $0<\mathrm{x}<\pi$ ব্যবধিতে $\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x})$ ফাংশনটির চরমমান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $2 g(x)=2 \sin x+\sin 2 x$

 

বা, $2 g(x)=2 \sin x+2 \sin x \cos x$

 

বা, $g(x)=\sin x+\sin x \cos x$

 

বা, $g(x)=\sin x(1+\cos x)$

 

বা, $g'(x)=\sin x \frac{d}{d x}(1+\cos x)+(1+\cos x) \frac{d}{d x}(\sin x)$

 

বা, $g'(x)=-\sin ^{2} x+\cos x(1+\cos x)$

 

বা, $g'(x)=-\sin ^{2} x+\cos x+\cos ^{2} x$

 

বা, $g'(x)=\cos x+\cos 2 x$

 

বা, $g''(x)=-\sin x-2 \sin 2 x$

 

এখন, চরমমানের জন্য, $\mathrm{g}'(\mathrm{x})=0$

 

বা, $\cos x+\cos 2 x=0$

 

বা, $\cos x+\cos ^{2} x-\sin ^{2} x=0$

 

বা, $\cos x+\cos ^{2} x-1+\cos ^{2} x=0 $

 

বা, $2 \cos ^{2} x+\cos x-1=0 $

 

বা, $2 \cos ^{2} x+2 \cos x-\cos x-1=0 $

 

বা, $2 \cos x(\cos x+1)-1(\cos x+1)=0 $

 

বা, $(2 \cos x-1)(\cos x+1)=0 $

 

হয়, $ 2 \cos x-1=0 $

 

বা, $ \cos x=\frac{1}{2} $

 

বা, $\cos x=\cos \frac{\pi}{3} $

 

$\therefore \quad x=\frac{\pi}{3} $

 

অথবা, $\cos x+1=0 $

 

বা, $ \cos x=-1 $

 

বা, $\cos x=\cos \pi $

 

$\therefore \mathbf{x}=\pi $

 

$\begin{aligned} & 0<\mathrm{x}<\pi \text { এর জন্য, } \mathrm{x}=\pi \text { গ্রহণয়োগ্য নয় } \\ & \therefore \mathrm{x}=\frac{\pi}{3} \\ & \text { এখন, } \mathrm{g}^{\prime \prime}\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=-\sin \frac{\pi}{3}-2 \sin \frac{2 \pi}{3}\end{aligned}$

 

$ =-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}-2, \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}-\sqrt{3}=\frac{-3 \sqrt{3}}{2}<0$

 

$\therefore \mathrm{x}=\frac{\pi}{3}$ এর জন্য $\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x})$ ফাংশনটির গুরুমান বিদ্যমান।

 

$\begin{aligned}\therefore \text { গুরুমান } & =\sin \frac{\pi}{3}\left(1+\cos \frac{\pi}{3}\right) \\& =\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\left(1+\frac{1}{2}\right)=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \times \frac{3}{2}=\frac{3 \sqrt{3}}{4}\end{aligned}$

 

নির্ণেয় গুরুমান $\frac{3 \sqrt{3}}{4}$.

questions.question: $\int\{\mathbf{f}(\mathbf{x})\}^{2} \mathbf{d x}$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\sin \mathrm{x}-\cos \mathrm{x}$

 

$\therefore \int\{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})\}^{2} \mathrm{dx}$

 

$=\int(\sin x-\cos x)^{2} d x$

 

$=\int\left(\sin ^{2} \mathrm{x}+\cos ^{2} \mathrm{x}-2 \sin \mathrm{x} \cdot \cos \mathrm{x}\right) \mathrm{dx}$

 

$=\int(1-\sin 2 \mathrm{x}) \mathrm{dx}$

 

$=\int \mathrm{dx}-\int \sin 2 \mathrm{xdx}=\mathrm{x}+\frac{\cos 2 \mathrm{x}}{2}+\mathrm{c}$

 

নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল : $x+\frac{\cos 2 x}{2}+c$.

questions.question: $\int \frac{1-f(x)}{1+f(x)} d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\sin \mathrm{x}-\cos \mathrm{x}$

 

ধরি, $\mathrm{I}=\int \frac{1-\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})}{1+\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})} \mathrm{dx}$

 

$\begin{aligned}& =\int \frac{1-(\sin x-\cos x)}{1+(\sin x-\cos x)} d x \\& =\int \frac{1-\sin x+\cos x}{1+\sin x-\cos x} d x\end{aligned}$

 

এখন, $1-\sin x+\cos x=l(1+\sin x-\cos x)+m \frac{d}{d x}(1+\sin x-\cos x)+n$

 

$=l(1+\sin x-\cos x)+m(\cos x+\sin x)+n.......... (i)$.

 

$=(1+n)+(1+m) \sin x+(-1+m) \cos x$.

 

উভয়পক্ষ হতে $\sin x, \cos x$ ও ধ্রুব পদ সমীকৃত করে পাই,

 

$1+n=1........... (ii)$

 

$1+m=-1.......... (iii)$

 

$-1+m=1$ ........... (iv)

 

এখন, (iii) + (iv) হতে, $2 \mathrm{~m}=0 \Rightarrow \mathrm{m}=0$

 

$\mathrm{m}=0$ হলে, (iii) হতে, $1=-1$

 

$1=-1$ হলে, (ii) হতে, $\mathrm{n}=2$

 

(i) নং হতে পাই,

 

$\begin{aligned}& I-\sin \mathrm{x}+\cos \mathrm{x}=-1(1+\sin \mathrm{x}-\cos \mathrm{x})+0+2 \\& \therefore I=\int \frac{-1(1+\sin \mathrm{x}-\cos \mathrm{x})+2}{1+\sin \mathrm{x}-\cos \mathrm{x}} \mathrm{dx} \\& =-\int \mathrm{dx}+2 \int \frac{1}{1+\sin \mathrm{x}-\cos \mathrm{x}} \mathrm{dx} \\& =-\mathrm{x}+2 \mathrm{I}_{1}\end{aligned}$

 

যেখানে, $\mathrm{I}_{1}=\int \frac{1}{1+\sin \mathrm{x}-\cos \mathrm{x}} \mathrm{dx}$

 

$=\int \frac{1}{1+\frac{2 \tan \frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}-\frac{1-\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}} d x$

 

$=\int \frac{1+\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}+2 \tan \frac{x}{2}-1+\tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}} d x$

 

$=\int \frac{\sec ^{2} \frac{x}{2}}{2 \tan ^{2} \frac{x}{2}+2 \tan \frac{x}{2}} d x$

 

$=\int \frac{2 d y}{2 y^{2}+2 y}$

 

ধরি, $\tan \frac{x}{2}=y$

 

বা, $\frac{1}{2} \sec ^{2} \frac{x}{2} d x=d y$

 

বা, $\sec ^{2} \frac{x}{2} d x=2 d y$

 

$=\int \frac{1}{\mathrm{y}(\mathrm{y}+1)} \mathrm{dy}=\int\left(\frac{1}{\mathrm{y}}-\frac{1}{\mathrm{y}+1}\right) \mathrm{dy}$

 

$=\ln \mathrm{y}-\ln (\mathrm{y}+1)+\mathrm{c}$

 

$=\ln \frac{y}{y+1}+c=\ln \frac{\tan \frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan \frac{x}{2}}+c$

 

$\therefore \mathrm{I}=-\mathrm{x}+2 \ln \frac{\tan \frac{\mathrm{x}}{2}}{1+\tan \frac{\mathrm{x}}{2}}+\mathrm{c}$

 

নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল : $-x+2 \ln \frac{\tan \frac{x}{2}}{1+\tan \frac{x}{2}}+c$.

questions.question: প্রমাণ কর, $\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \mathrm{~g}(\cos \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta=\frac{3 \pi}{32}+\frac{1}{4}$.
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{g}(\mathrm{x})=\mathrm{x}^{4}$

 

$\therefore \mathrm{g}(\cos \theta)=\cos ^{4} \theta$

 

এখন, $\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} g(\cos \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \cos ^{4} \theta \mathrm{d} \theta$

 

$=\frac{1}{4} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\left(2 \cos ^{2} \theta\right)^{2} \mathrm{~d} \theta=\frac{1}{4} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}(1+\cos 2 \theta)^{2} \mathrm{~d} \theta$

 

$=\frac{1}{4} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\left(1+2 \cos 2 \theta+\cos ^{2} 2 \theta\right) \mathrm{d} \theta$

 

$=\frac{1}{4}\left[\theta+2 \frac{\sin 2 \theta}{2}\right]_{0}^{-\frac{\pi}{4}}+\frac{1}{4.2} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} 2 \cos ^{2} 2 \theta \mathrm{d} \theta$

 

$=\frac{1}{4}\left[\left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\sin \frac{\pi}{2}\right)-0\right]+\frac{1}{8} \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}(1+\cos 4 \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta$

 

$=\frac{\pi}{16}+\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{8}\left[\theta+\frac{\sin 4 \theta}{4}\right]_{0}^{-\frac{\pi}{4}}$

 

$=\frac{\pi}{16}+\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{8}\left[\left(\frac{\pi}{4}+\frac{\sin \pi}{4}\right)-0\right]$

 

$=\frac{\pi}{16}+\frac{1}{4}+\frac{\pi}{32}+0=\frac{3 \pi}{32}+\frac{1}{4}$

 

$\therefore \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \mathrm{~g}(\cos \theta) \mathrm{d} \theta=\frac{3 \pi}{32}+\frac{1}{4}$ (প্রমাণিত)

questions.question: $\int \frac{5 \mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}}{1+\mathrm{e}^{4 \mathrm{x}}} \mathrm{dx}$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
$\int \frac{5 \mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}}{1+\mathrm{e}^{4 \mathrm{x}}} \mathrm{dx} $

 

$=\int \frac{5 \mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}}{1+\left(\mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}\right)^{2}} \mathrm{dx} $

 

ধরি, $\mathrm{y}=\mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}$

 

বা, $\mathrm{dy}=2 \mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}} \mathrm{dx} $

 

$=\frac{5}{2} \int \frac{2 \mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}} \mathrm{dx}}{1+\left(\mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}\right)^{2}}=\frac{5}{2} \int \frac{\mathrm{dy}}{1+\mathrm{y}^{2}}=\frac{5}{2}, \tan ^{-1} \mathrm{y}+\mathrm{c}=\frac{5}{2} \tan ^{-1} \mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}+\mathrm{c}$

 

নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল : $\frac{5}{2} \tan ^{-1} \mathrm{e}^{2 \mathrm{x}}+\mathrm{c}$.

questions.question: $\int\left[\frac{1+\{f(x)\}^{2}}{1+f(x)}+\frac{1}{f(x)+\sqrt{f(x)}+1}\right] d x$ নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\mathrm{x}^{2}$

 

$\therefore \int\left[\frac{1+\{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})\}^{2}}{1+\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})}+\frac{1}{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})+\sqrt{\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})}+1}\right] \mathrm{dx}$

 

$=\int\left[\frac{1+\mathrm{x}^{4}}{1+\mathrm{x}^{2}}+\frac{1}{\mathrm{x}^{2}+\mathrm{x}+1}\right] \mathrm{dx}$

 

$=\int \frac{x^{2}\left(1+x^{2}\right)+1-x^{2}}{1+x^{2}} d x+\int \frac{1}{x^{2}+2 \cdot x \cdot \frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{4}+1-\frac{1}{4}} d x$

 

$=\int x^{2} d x+\int \frac{1-x^{2}}{1+x^{2}} d x+\int \frac{1}{\left(x+\frac{1}{2}\right)^{2}+\frac{3}{4}} d x$

 

$=\frac{x^{3}}{3}+\int \frac{-\left(1+x^{2}\right)+2}{1+x^{2}} d x+\int \frac{1}{\left(x+\frac{1}{2}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^{2}} d x$

 

$=\frac{x^{3}}{3}-\int 1 d x+2 \int \frac{1}{1+x^{2}} d x+\frac{1}{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}} \tan ^{-1} \frac{x+\frac{1}{2}}{\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}}$

 

$=\frac{x^{3}}{3}-x+2 \tan ^{-1} x+\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{2 x+1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)+c$

 

নির্ণেয় যোজিত ফল : $\frac{x^{3}}{3}-x+2 \tan ^{-1} x+\frac{2}{\sqrt{3}} \tan ^{-1}\left(\frac{2 x+1}{\sqrt{3}}\right)+c$.

questions.question: $\int_{1}^{2}\left[\sqrt{f(x)} e^{f(x)}+\frac{\{f(x)-1\}^{2}}{f(x)}\right] d x$ এর মান নির্ণয় কর।
questions.answer:
দেওয়া আছে, $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\mathrm{x}^{2}$

 

$\begin{aligned} \mid & \therefore \int_1^2\left[\sqrt{f(x)} e^{f(x)}+\frac{f(x)-1\}^2}{f(x)}\right] d x=\int_1^2\left[\sqrt{x^2} e^{x^2}+\frac{\left(x^2-1\right)^2}{x^2}\right] d x \\ & =\int_1^2 \mathrm{x} e^{x^2} d x+\int_1^2 \frac{x^4-2 x^2+1}{x^2} d x \\ & =\frac{1}{2} \int_1^2 2 x e^{x^2} d x+\int_1^2\left(x^2-2+x^{-2}\right) d x \\ & =\frac{1}{2} \int_1^2 e^{x^2} \mathrm{~d}\left(x^2\right)+\left[\frac{x^3}{3}-2 x+\frac{x^{-2+1}}{-2+1}\right]_1^2=\frac{1}{2}\left[e^{x^2}\right]_1^2+\left[\frac{x^3}{3}-2 x-\frac{1}{x}\right]_1^2 \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\left(e^4-e^1\right)+\left(\frac{8}{3}-4-\frac{1}{2}\right)-\left(\frac{1}{3}-2-1\right) \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\left(e^4-e\right)+\frac{16-24-3}{6}-\frac{1-9}{3} \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\left(e^4-e\right)+\frac{-11}{6}+\frac{8}{3}=\frac{1}{2}\left(e^4-e\right)+\frac{8}{3}-\frac{11}{6} \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\left(e^4-e\right)+\frac{16-11}{6} \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\left(e^4-e\right)+\frac{5}{6}\end{aligned}$

 

নির্ণেয় মান : $\frac{1}{2}\left(e^{4}-e\right)+\frac{5}{6}$.
